reason: Fast Landing tests-only diagnostic authorization for the remaining KF-P0-19/KF-P0-22 WhatsApp stale-generation async-continuation seam. The live candidate is longer-lived asynchronous work launched from guarded Baileys callbacks, especially messages.upsert avatarService.enqueueWhatsApp(...).then(...) and history/contact avatar synchronization continuations: they can be launched while the socket is current, outlive a stop/replacement generation invalidation, then record avatar/identity state or publish completion effects without a fresh socketGuard current check at the completion boundary. Initial implementation is exactly one mandatory WP0 test path and production is forbidden until fresh exact-head causal RED(s) exhaust this same-root async-continuation graph with unknownBlockers=0. Existing createSessionGenerationFence/createSocketGenerationGuard authority, synchronous messageRepository commit semantics, persisted operation fencing, and syncCheckpoint authority are PRESERVE. No second scheduler, queue, retry engine, session authority, dependency, workflow or routing change is authorized.
